_about: Yakuza teardown (mhvnsnt/teardown-yakuza, PR-Y3 / step 6, system Y15) — the civic-help effects table: the Poundmate-class roster of helpers a Ranger can call on, declared as data beside bond-effects-table.json under the same declaration discipline. A helper with NO row here does not exist in battle; a row with NO cue is a data error (the declaration law, second family — kept separate from the bond table on purpose, per the Y15 taxonomy fence). Ships EMPTY-BUT-VALID: the roster content is owner slot 7 and is never invented by the wiring. Battle consumption is QUEUED on the battle seat; this file is data only.

rowShape.conditions: { band?, placeClass?, opponentClass? } — all optional; band reads a derived band, never a stored value
rowShape.cost: declared cost of the call (kind + amount as data)
rowShape.cue: MANDATORY visible staging for the help — a helper whose help cannot be seen does not exist
rowShape.effect: { kind, parameters } — the declared effect kind + its parameters
rowShape.restBattles: number of battles the helper rests after a call
rowShape.unlockFlag: story/system flag that unlocks this helper
